old_text:
3.1 All items purchased for the Income Generating Office operations shall be inspected first before used or sold.
3.2 A Special Order shall be issued to the workers before assumption to duty.
3.3 Student laborers shall observe proper limitations as to their assigned tasks.
3.4 All income shall be deposited to the depository bank on the following day.
3.5 The University President or designated officer shall approve all activities undertaken by the Income Generating Office operation.
3.6 Income Generating Project Proposal/s shall be reviewed by the Board of Management (BOM) and approved by the University President and the Board of Regents (BOR) before the start of any Income Generating Project.
3.7 The Board of Management shall periodically update the University President of Income Generating Office activities.
3.8 Promissory notes of LNU employees and parents of the students/pupils shall be approved by the University President.
3.9 Income Generating Office shall coordinate with all project managers and shall set a deadline for PPMPs to give ample time for them to review, revise and prepare.
3.10 Any record, which may contain personal information, shall be handled in accordance with R.A. 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.11 Any request for information shall be governed by E.O. No. 2, series of 2016 or the Freedom of Information Policy.

3.8 Promissory notes of LNU employees and parents of the students/pupils shall be approved by the University President.

3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. 3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

old_text:
3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.

3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation ,interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. 3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. 3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.

3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. 3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.

3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

| Responsibility | Activity |
| --- | --- |
| Student | 1. Gives the Application for Student Records. |
| Accounting Staff-4 | 2. Receives the Application for Student Records from the student. |
| | 3. Checks the ledger/account of the students using the Student Information and Accounting System (SIAS). |
| | 4. Signs the Application if the student has no financial accountabilities. |
| | 5. If the student still has financial accountabilities, advises the student to settle first the accountabilities to the Cash Management Office. Then, after its settlement, signs the Application of the student. |
| | 6. Releases the Application for Student Records to the student. |
| Student | 7. Gets the signed Application for Student Records. |

old_text:
3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 Any request for information shall be governed by Executive Order No. 02, series of 2016 or the Freedom of Information.
3.3 All student claims should be supported with complete and proper documents.
3.4 There should be a timely release of allowances to the students based on the timing stated in the applicable rulings, manual, or provisions of the Memoradum of Agreement.
3.5 Student records such as Transfer Credential, Transcript of Records, and Certificate of Good Moral Character should only be released upon full settlement of the student with his/her accountabilities with the University.
3.6 Only the student can claim his/her labor, allowance, stipend, subsidies, or refund. However, if teh student cannot claim it personally, he/she can authorize someone to claim his/her receivables on his/her behalf. The authorization should be supported with an Authorization Letter signed by the student together with the photocopies of one (1) valid Identification Document (ID) of the student, and of the authorized person. In claiming, the original copies of IDs of the students and of the authorized person should be presented to the Special Disbursing Officer for cross-checking of their authenticity.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall not focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program can focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.

3.1 Any records which may contain personal information shall be handled in accordance with the Republic Act 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.2 The learning and development of all academic and non-academic staff shall include a multi-pronged scheme for scholarship/fellowship, research assistance, training, sabbatical leave, and other forms of grants that would enhance the academic and professional competencies of the faculty and staff.
3.3 Pursuant to the provisions of Sec 2, Rule VIII of the Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of EO 292, this Career and Personnel Development Plan is hereby established for reference and guidance.
3.3.1 The Leyte Normal University (LNU) values its human resources as an asset of the government and commits to establish a systematic program of career and personnel development for every official and employees.
3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.
3.3.6 A portion of the total faculty and staff shall be sent for a scholarship/fellowship every school year except in very rare cases wherein the total number faculty and staff scholars may exceed from what is allowed within a year. In such cases, the University President shall exercise discretion to allow other applicant to go on study leave provided the applicant submit certifications that the degrees to be pursued are direly needed by the university to be issued by the Unit Chair.

3.3.2 The Career and Personnel Development Plan shall include a variety of human resource development interventions on merit promotion, performance evaluation, participation in conferences and seminars (local and foreign), foreign and local scholarship and training grants; suggestions, incentives award systems, provision for welfare, counseling, coaching, job rotation, secondment detail, job shifting and others.
3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.

3.3.3 The program also considers as a major organizational goal the building of professional culture that is not only competent and efficient but also one where there is maximum cooperation, interaction and socialization among employees.
3.3.4 The program shall focus on rewarding exemplary performance providing avenues for remedial action of underperforming employees when necessary.
3.3.5 A portion of the Agency budget shall be allocated for this purpose (LNU Career & Development Plan) taken from the University income and incorporated in the Agency annual budget estimates for the Fiscal year.

3.1 All items purchased for the Income Generating Office operations shall be inspected first before used or sold.
3.2 A Special Order shall be issued to the workers before assumption to duty.
3.3 Student laborers shall observe proper limitations as to their assigned tasks.
3.4 All income shall be deposited to teh depository bank on the following day.
3.5 The University President or designated officer shall approve all activities undertaken by the Income Generating Office operation.
3.6 Income Generating Project Proposal/s shall be reviewed by the Board of Management (BOM) and approved by the University President and the Board of Regents (BOR) before the start of any Income Generating Project.
3.7 The Board of Management shall periodically update the University President of Income Generating Office activities.
3.8 Promissory notes of LNU employees and parents of the students/pupils shall be approved by the University President.
3.9 Income Generating Office shall coordinate with all project managers and shall set a deadline for PPMPs to give ample time for them to review, revise and prepare.
3.10 Any record, which may contain personal information, shall be handled in accordance with R.A. 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
3.11 Any request for information shall be governed by E.O. No. 2, series of 2016 or the Freedom of Information Policy.
